title: The Southlands
text:
The world grows south and the cramped zones get room to breathe.

✨ The Southlands: the world now runs much further south. Gloamfen is nearly twice the size, a wide stretch of Amberfield farmland opens below Mirrowmere, and Frostpeak and the Stormwake Coast reach further south. Take the new road from Hearthmere's east gate
✨ Four new places to discover: Amberfield Farmsteads, Southwatch Camp, the Sowing Stones and the Mirefall Shrine
• Amberfield has room to breathe: starting monsters now spread across the open land south of the lake instead of crowding the strip north of town, and boar herds and wolf packs roam the far south
